snippet.title: [Black Vultures] Gameplay Trailer｜In-Game Trailer｜BLACKVULTURES
snippet.description:
Add it to your Steam wishlist and join us for the playtest coming in July 2025: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/

We’re thrilled to reveal the first gameplay footage of Black Vultures: Prey of Greed, developed by THISMEANSWAR and published by WEMADE.
Black Vultures is a tactical first-person shooter set in a fractured warzone where trust is scarce, resources are limited, and every mission begins with a choice. Navigate ruined infrastructure and contested zones. Intercept transmissions, track movements, and recover intel to locate your objective before rival squads close in. Engage only when necessary. Retreat when survival demands it. The deeper you push, the higher the risk, but greater the reward.

_____________________________________________

Learn more about the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/
Join our Discord Server: http://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame
Follow us on X: https://x.com/bv_community


#BlackVultures #FPS #Military #fps2025 #multiplayershooter #steamgame
